works.body:
Hello, Mr. Ebi!
It's nice to meet you!
I saw your illustration of Rimuru-chan from Tensura by chance, and I was so fascinated that I even started watching the anime I had stopped watching again, so I requested it!
https://x.com/abbbikun/status/1861303611097260104
https://x.com/abbbikun/status/1719368234665947400

The character I'd like to request is my original character "Abyss-kun"!

Character
Abyss-kun
Motiv is a character based on the monster "Water Abyss Magician" from the game "Hara-Kami", who was branded as a traitor for saving a human girl who had saved him at one point. After being branded a traitor for saving the human girl who saved him at one point, he became disillusioned with the cult and fled, only to be transformed into a human by a god.
https://kamigame.jp/genshin/page/127012493011779521.html
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=D0a86CmDzOQ&t=1s
He is a water elementalist and his special skill is the ability to create large soap bubbles.
She enjoys playing with soap bubbles with her children when she leaves her part-time job or on her days off, and sometimes she likes to get into mischief and keep her sisters trapped in large soap bubbles.
I would like her pose to be sitting on a cushion made of soap bubbles.
Her body shape is similar to Liam's.
If possible, it would be helpful if you could pay attention to the surface and luster of the soap bubbles.

I have included the character's materials here.
https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fo/g1sk24w20sjma3zf53ytk/AIrP2Ns9qFfMFYqhihYigk8?rlkey=xtoralw48fni3kgpvw9csdfwn&st=j5e30exq&dl=0

Best regards!

はじめまして！(｀・ω・´)ゞ
先生の転スラファンアートの大ファンなので、私のVtuberの絵をお願いしたいです。

リムルスライムのぬいぐるみと一緒に描いたら可愛いと思うのですが、お好きなように描いていただいて構いません。できれば、好きな服を着て描いていただけませんか？シュナとシオンのラフがとてもかわいいです！

デザイン、髪型は自由ですが、金のかんざしは外さないでください。髪を束ねたとき、顔の左側の髪が右側より長くなっています。髪を下ろしているときは、右側が長くなっています。もし不可能なら、「衣装2」にあるような黒いインナードレスを着て描いてください。手袋も忘れずに。

魔女として異世界を旅していた、猫のような性格のツンデレ司書。本が好きで魔法が使え、珊瑚色のメンダコが相棒。猫の口と牙が特徴。目には蝶、背中には蝶のマークがあります。

よろしくお願いします！
